hero.label: Book
hero.title: Book a car inspection
hero.subtitle: Pre-purchase car inspection in Kaunas, Vilnius, Klaipėda, Šiauliai, Panevėžys and across Lithuania. Get in touch, we respond within a few hours.

form.label: Booking
form.title: Choose an inspection time
form.subtitle: Fill in a short request, choose a real available time, and we will confirm the appointment by email.
form.step_time_text: Only admin-approved available times are shown.
form.step_details_text: Leave only what we need to arrange the visit.
form.inspection_type_full_meta: Bodywork, diagnostics, test drive, and a clear conclusion.
form.inspection_type_diagnostics_meta: OBD faults, live data, and a short explanation.
form.slot_hint: The time becomes a confirmed appointment only after admin review.
form.selected_empty: Your selected time will appear here.
form.message_placeholder: Anything important about the car, seller, or timing?
form.legal_consent_prefix: I have read and accept the
form.legal_consent_middle: and confirm that I have read the
form.early_service_consent: I agree that the service may begin before the end of the 14-day contract withdrawal period if my selected and confirmed appointment time falls within that period. I understand that once the service has been fully performed, I will lose the right to withdraw from the contract, and if the service has started but is not completed, I may have to pay a proportionate amount for the part of the service provided and reasonable expenses.
form.vehicle_access_consent: I confirm that I am responsible for the car being accessible at the agreed time and for the seller, owner, or lawful holder allowing the inspection, diagnostics, and, if agreed and safe, a test drive.
form.marketing_consent: I agree to receive checkauto.lt news, tips, and offers by email. I understand that I can withdraw this consent at any time.
form.success: Request received. The selected time is temporarily reserved; we will send confirmation by email.
form.rate_limited: Too many requests were sent. Please try again later.
form.error: The booking request could not be sent. Please try again or email info@checkauto.lt.
